help.title: 🤖 BMS Teams Bot - Available Commands
help.description: I help you search railway documentation and answer questions about procedures, technical specs, and safety guidelines.

commands.description: Get a direct answer to your question with source citations
commands.example: /ask What are the emergency brake procedures for Class 395?

commands.description: Search for relevant documents without generating an answer
Upload a document for indexing (or attach file directly to message)
Check the processing status of an uploaded document
View your search history from the last 7 days
Admin commands to manage channel whitelist (admins only)

tips: 💡 You can ask questions in natural language - no need for exact keywords
💡 The bot remembers conversation context for 7 days
💡 All answers include citations showing which documents were used
💡 Upload documents by attaching files directly to your message
help.footer: Response time: <3 seconds | Context retention: 7 days | Supported formats: PDF, CSV, XLSX, XLS, TXT, MD, DOCX, PPTX

query_tips: Try using specific technical terms (e.g., 'Class 395 brake system' instead of 'brakes')
Include document type if known (e.g., 'safety procedure', 'technical manual')
Break complex questions into simpler parts
Use /search for exploratory queries, /ask for specific questions
